title: GG 1 · Claim Overview: claim not in Global Genius
walkthroughSteps: Claim level: the banner only appears when the claim is not (yet) in Global Genius. Normal claims show nothing new.
Claim not set up: you can send the claim again yourself (PO request, DESIGN DECISION GG-2).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Claim Overview · Claim couldn't be set up in GG
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-001.

**You see:** Red banner: payments and reserves are on hold, with a **Send claim to Global Genius again** button.

**Try:** Press the button: banner turns blue ("still being set up"), then disappears after ~3 seconds and the bell shows "now set up".

acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-001.

**You see:** Same red banner as AC-01.

**Try:** Press Send again: it goes blue, then comes back red after ~3 seconds.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Claim Overview · Claim's policy isn't in GG
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-001.

**You see:** Red banner saying the policy team has been told. **No** Send again button (nothing you can resend until they add the policy).
